executionMode: contract-driven execution in the resolved direct, structured, or program mode
ownershipRule: preserve unrelated changes and use disjoint write scopes when delegating
fallback: stop on a material blocker or exhausted budget, preserve the result, and report what remains
testDiscipline: use test-first evidence when required by the resolved contract; capture required ledger checks as command-run evidence
workflowContract: explicit intent, impact scope, consequence risk, and bounded whole-task budget
